plain: The crime of making a fake document, signature, or money

webster.text: The act of forging or working metal into shape.

more.text: The act of falsifying; the crime of counterfeiting; as the forgery of coin, or of bank notes, or of a bond.

example.quote: For besides that the letters ascribed to them are often the most palpable forgeries, dictated by the extravagant zeal of party, it is not to be denied that such as are genuine breathe an obvious spirit of partiality that turns away the ear of every discerning enquirer after truth.
example.cite: James Madison, Political Reflections, Aurora General Advertiser, Feb. 23, 1799
